description: Builds the dependency graph of a project: imports/includes/requires, Godot res:// loads and scene resources, Unity script/prefab GUIDs, and type references (C#, GDScript class_name/autoloads, Java…). JS/TS monorepos: imports of workspace packages by name, tsconfig paths aliases, package.json #imports and Deno import maps resolve to their files, and a workspace section shows which package uses which. Returns entry points, cycles, orphans, most-used files, external packages and the port order (dependencies first). format:"mermaid" adds a diagram.

limit.description: Files in portOrder (default 30; edges 15, other lists 20). Larger values return more of every list.

name: re_graph
title: Dependency graph and port order
